description_expanded: This beautiful home on North Charles Street has never before been on the rental program since completion in 2020. The home is a short distance to the emerging Town Center, the Caliza Pool complex as well as the Gulf. The home provides very inviting outdoor space on the first level including a courtyard with private pool, shaded seating and a built-in grill. Inside, guests will enjoy a bedroom with a king-sized bed and private bath as well as a spacious, open family room and kitchen with a large center island. On the second floor, there are three bedrooms and three full baths including the master suite, each with one king-sized bed. An extra room with one set of bunk beds as well as well as the laundry room are also found on this level. Finally, a spacious patio on the second floor provides additional outdoor seating to enjoy Gulf breezes. Parking for this home is located in a two-car garage. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
